title: Discharge bounded codec fits and regional entry seeds
scope: Authorized ST-W6..W8 campaign; generic AIR validation only, no new source-language rules
authority: analysis-ir@31893d1f4d203d19a61a750e2c4220120d9dab84 especificacao/02-tipos-valores-e-operandos.md fit_text and I-46 codec exact write
rule: fit_text produces exactly n characters; IBM1047 Read yields only scalars in its bijective 256-scalar repertoire. Fitting with a representable one-scalar pad preserves that repertoire, so a destination with the same codec and extent n accepts all possible results.
algorithm: Check direct FitText over Read once per write; compare declared source codec and destination extent, encode single pad. O(1) in inventory cardinality; no value-flow execution, recursion or byte allocation proportional to n.
premises: Normative FitText length and explicit codec identity; no corpus assumptions. Existing range and read checks remain in force.
oracle: A two-byte IBM1047 read fitted to four bytes is total; truncating to one is total. Unrepresentable pad, unknown/ascii source codec and mismatched result extent do not discharge this proof.
qualification: W6 12/12 G2 PASS; W7 12/12 G2 PASS; W8 technical G3 PASS (composed unchanged evidence + affected RC3 requalification).
